collection_method: Release seed; replaced by fetch_news.py on the next data refresh.

items.headline: Fed expected to pause in October, with economists looking to another rate rise in December
items.summary: A Reuters poll found a strong consensus for no October move, followed by renewed tightening in December.
items.why_it_matters: US rate expectations feed Treasury yields, the dollar, global liquidity and equity valuations.

items.headline: European shares slip as unrest in France adds to debt and growth concerns
items.summary: European equities ended slightly lower as investors weighed French political unrest, elevated yields and corporate earnings.
items.why_it_matters: Political and fiscal stress can lift sovereign risk premiums and affect European equities, the euro and global risk appetite.

items.headline: US single-family housing starts fall and permits hit a multi-year low
items.summary: September single-family construction weakened as mortgage rates and affordability continued to pressure housing demand.
items.why_it_matters: Housing is one of the clearest transmission channels from interest rates into construction, household demand and credit.

items.headline: Foreign banks increasingly use acquisitions to expand in India
items.summary: Large cross-border investments are highlighting renewed strategic interest in India's banking and financial-services market.
items.why_it_matters: Foreign capital into banks can affect competition, valuations, credit capacity and broader confidence in India's financial system.

items.headline: China's US soybean imports rebound from zero a year earlier
items.summary: September customs data showed renewed US soybean shipments to China after the previous year's trade disruption.
items.why_it_matters: Agricultural trade is a useful signal for US-China commercial relations, commodity demand and shipping flows.

items.headline: Chinese technology groups place large orders for Nvidia export-compliant chips
items.summary: Strong orders from ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent point to continued demand for AI compute despite export restrictions.
items.why_it_matters: AI infrastructure spending can move semiconductor demand, technology equities, power requirements and US-China supply-chain exposure.

items.headline: India's September merchandise trade deficit widens to $30.21 billion
items.summary: Imports rose faster than exports in September, widening the goods deficit despite export growth in several sectors.
items.why_it_matters: A wider merchandise deficit can pressure the current account and rupee, especially when energy imports are expensive.

items.headline: Oil-market supply risk rises as geopolitical tensions push crude higher
items.summary: Fresh shipping and infrastructure risks have put energy security back at the centre of global market attention.
items.why_it_matters: Higher crude prices can raise Indian inflation, weaken the trade balance and add pressure to the rupee.
